verdict.rationale: A offers the earliest arrival and lowest SFO fare, B offers a materially larger connection buffer for a time-sensitive next-morning demo, and D is the lowest-priced option but requires using Oakland and has the latest arrival. The query provides no preference regarding airport convenience, fare savings, or connection-risk tolerance, so no option clearly dominates. C is less compelling than A because its modestly longer connection comes with both a higher fare and substantially later arrival.
